title: The relief column

branches.condition: Civilian relief arrives and Spear intercepts a patrol
branches.consequence: The interception finds its target after delivered Deliver Relief from Wayfarer, Lantern or Grey Petrel. At opening Readiness 2+, it achieves combat at total Stability −2. At 0–1, disable Spear: Stability −1 and no qualifying combat.

branches.condition: Civilian relief does not arrive and Spear intercepts a patrol
branches.consequence: No target: Stability −1, no qualifying combat and Spear remains intact. Troop transport and private trade do not qualify.

branches.condition: Spear does not intercept a patrol
branches.consequence: No interception effects. A vetoed interception does not launch and incurs no interception cost.

public_rules: Delivered civilian relief qualifies even if Transport Troops also succeeds. A standing interception veto bars both the council and independent versions. Readiness changes once after all operations.
